meta.name: novel-to-game
meta.description: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on the selected target platform. Orchestrates the whole adaptation pipeline — requirements intake, gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and visual design, target-runtime build, and evidence-based QA — for a novel in any language. Use for novel to game, story to game, book to game, adapt this novel into a game, turn this book into a playable prototype, make an interactive story or text adventure from this novel. NovelToGame 总入口。把任意语言的原始小说、拆文库或 oh-story 写作工程转成有原著依据、可在目标平台完整游玩的游戏，编排游戏化拆解、概念选择、游戏与视觉设计、目标运行环境构建和证据化质量验证。用于小说转游戏、把这本书做成游戏、把小说改成互动小说 / 互动叙事 / 文字冒险游戏等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把小说改编成可在目标平台游玩的完整游戏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一部小说或故事,想把它变成能亲自玩到的游戏
copy.tagline_en: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on your chosen platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a novel or story and want to play it as a game.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像导演一样把小说改编成可玩游戏。它会先起草产品简介，再依次完成剧情拆解、概念选择、世界观与美术设计、原型构建和质量验证，最后产出设计文档和可玩原型。
howto.when: 当你说要把小说、故事或书改编成游戏，或要求做成可玩原型、文字冒险等时触发。

say.text: 把这部小说改编成游戏。
say.note: Claude 会启动完整改编流程并先起草产品简介。

say.text: 用这本书做一个可玩原型。
say.note: 它会按风险选择最小切片并构建试玩版本。

say.text: 把这个故事做成文字冒险游戏。
say.note: 它会拆解剧情并产出互动叙事设计。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude directs turning a novel into a playable game: drafts a brief, then runs story deconstruction, concept choice, world/art design, prototype build, and QA, outputting design docs and a playable prototype.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn a novel, story, or book into a game, or request a playable prototype, interactive fiction, or text adventure.

say_en.text: Turn this novel into a game.
say_en.note: Starts the pipeline and drafts a brief.

say_en.text: Make a playable prototype from this book.
say_en.note: Selects a minimal slice by risk and builds a test version.

say_en.text: Turn this story into a text adventure.
say_en.note: Deconstructs the plot and designs interactive narrative.
